summary: Ran the Demo path end to end on fresh visitors, through the API and the UI. Working: assistant demo setup (mode demo, project.demo true, 4-5 sites, start date, weeks and 4 partners saved, reply says the figures are made up and unverified); the real-project guard; draft, evidence and select; review links (.test addresses: email-preview sendable=false, email-send 400, no mail sent); each partner confirms only its own scope (no other firm's email or price shown, other firms' links return 403); quote issue (snapshot demo:true, one 'Sxx Name: scope' line per assigned site, no firm names, emails or partner prices); organizer accept without a customer session returns 401; customer code shown on screen for .test addresses; customer accept; amendment issue and accept (v1 digest and snapshot unchanged, repeat accept returns the same receipt); capacity 'per week' fills every week. UI: demo-tag, inspector-review-as-partner, the switch to the partner's review page (review-demo-tag, review-back-to-organizer) and back, report-print-button, the quote page (quote-demo-tag, quote-line-items-view, quote-print, code, then accept with a receipt) and not-found all work. Two real bugs found: (1) the POST /draft generator ignores each firm's quoted max_sites, so the demo plan failed the checker and could not be selected in 2 of 2 runs; (2) two independent base offers can be issued and both accepted.

critical.issue: The generator never checks partner max_sites. It fills the cheapest firm up to its weekly capacity, so the quoted_limits rule fails (e.g. 'Redwood Electrical has 3 site(s) but quoted at most 2.'). Then plan/select returns 409 'Plan v1 fails a check'. This happened in both fresh demo runs, so the demo flow stops at Select unless the user moves sites by hand. The assistant 'advance' path also uses make_draft, so it is affected too; it passed once only because that scenario's limits happened to fit.

POST /quotes with amend_of=None while an earlier offer is issued but not yet accepted creates a new kind='offer' with replaces=None. Issuing it does not supersede the earlier one. The customer can then accept both, which gives 2 accepted base offers (seen in prj_ffb0e7f10da0: Q1 accepted, Q2 accepted, Q3 an amendment of Q2 accepted). Fix: in new_quote, set replaces to the latest open (issued or changes_requested) quote when no accepted quote exists, or refuse. In respond accept, refuse a base offer when the project already has an accepted quote.

minor.issue: A new amendment draft does not carry over the baseline's condition_decisions, so every amendment needs all 5 conditions decided again before it can be issued.

The demo scenario leaves gaps: payer is unknown for every partner, scope_summary is null, and own crew capacity is unknown. The demo shows 14 open 'unknown' items, the checker shows 'conditions unknown', and the review page shows 'Your scope: Unknown' and 'Exclusions: Unknown'.

line_items are not passed through scrub(), unlike exclusions and conditions. A site scope containing a firm name or email would reach the customer. There was no leak in these runs: a site called 'Cedar Ridge Library' appeared, but that is the site name, not the firm.
Unauthenticated and not rate limited. Each call replaces the code and, for real addresses, sends an email.

ui_bugs.issue: After Q4 is accepted, the banner still says 'Your accepted Q3 ($81,000.00) stays in force unless you accept this amendment.' This is stale and confusing.

issues: Every package card title repeats the full long job name ('District-wide LED lighting retrofit, Sacramento Valley, California: 1 site'), so the four cards are hard to tell apart.
The header firm comes from the account ('Cedar Grid Services') but the title uses the scenario name ('Cedar Power Services'). The two names don't match in the demo.

action_items: Make logic.generate respect partner max_sites: count sites per owner and skip an owner once it reaches max_sites, so the demo and real drafts pass quoted_limits and can be selected.

Stop two live base offers: in new_quote, set replaces to the open issued quote when there is no accepted one, and/or reject a base-offer accept in /quote/{token}/respond when an accepted quote already exists.
Carry condition_decisions from the baseline into amendment drafts.
Have demo generation fill in payer, scope_summary and own capacity (or include_own=false) so the demo isn't cluttered with 'unknown' items.
Scrub firm names and emails from snapshot line_items as well.
Fix the stale 'stays in force unless you accept' banner after an amendment is accepted.
critical_code_review_comments: logic.py generate(): the max_sites check is missing (root cause of the select 409).
quote_routes.new_quote: 'replaces' is only set when amend_of is passed, so a fresh offer never supersedes an open one.
extract_routes every_week regex runs on the whole excerpt; a phrase like 'capacity 1 per week in weeks 2-3' without a parsed week would fill every week.

success_rate.backend: 82% (9/11; the 2 failing tests are strict checks for the 2 bugs above)

seed_data_creation: Created demo projects for visitors t28-bcb38efde7b3 (prj_ffb0e7f10da0, Q1-Q4, with the double accept) and t28-d402909aec0c (prj_6a156ce94815), plus t28a-*, t28c-*, t28q-* sandboxes. No fixture or real projects were touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: pytest tests/test_iter28_demo_e2e.py (about 2-3 minutes with 3-4 LLM calls). test_04 contains a workaround for the max_sites bug: it moves excess sites with plan/assign, adds evidence, then runs preview/select and plan/select, and sets CTX quoted_limits_bug, which makes test_08 fail. Once the generator is fixed, test_08 should pass without the workaround firing. test_09 reproduces the two-offer double accept on an empty project. The context of the last run is saved in /app/test_reports/iter28_demo_ctx.json (resume() lets tests 04-09 rerun against it).
rca of the issue: Select 409: logic.generate() loops through owners sorted by price and only checks remaining[o][week] > 0. It never compares against p['max_sites'], while the checker's quoted_limits rule (logic.py ~518) does. Double accept: new_quote() sets replaces only when amend_of is given and nothing is accepted yet; issue_quote() supersedes only q['replaces']; respond() accepts any issued quote whatever the other quotes' states are.
